sloka: यद्यपि प्रतिपत्तिस्ते दैवी चापि तयोर्मतम् ।तथा प्युपेक्षणीयम् ते न मे तदपि रोचते ॥२-२३-१५॥
transliteration: yadyapi pratipattiste daivī cāpi tayormatam ।tathā pyupekṣaṇīyam te na me tadapi rocate ॥2-23-15॥

translations.english: It might be your opinion that their dictate is the decree of destiny. Even then, it does not satisfy me. It (destiny) should be ignored.
